title: LinkedIn Post Engagers Input
description: Paste LinkedIn post URLs. The actor returns the people who commented and reacted, deduped into one lead row per person per post.

postUrls.title: Post URLs
postUrls.description: LinkedIn post or share URLs, or raw activity URNs. Examples: 'https://www.linkedin.com/posts/satyanadella_ai-activity-7180000000000000000-abcd', 'urn:li:activity:7180000000000000000'.

scrapeComments.title: Include commenters
scrapeComments.description: Add people who commented on the post. Their comment text and reply count are attached to the lead row.

scrapeReactions.title: Include reactors
scrapeReactions.description: Add people who reacted to the post. Their reaction type (like, celebrate, support, and so on) is attached to the lead row.

maxEngagersPerPost.title: Max engagers per post
maxEngagersPerPost.description: Hard cap on engager rows per post after the comment and reaction lists are merged. Set to 0 for every engager the public embed exposes.

includePostSummary.title: Include a post summary row
includePostSummary.description: Push one extra row per post with the author, body snippet, and total reaction, comment, and repost counts so each lead row has context. Not charged.

concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.description: Number of posts processed in parallel. Higher runs faster but raises proxy and detection risk. Four is a safe default.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy. Residential is required for LinkedIn at any meaningful volume.
